tool.name: Beacon2 Analyses
tool.description: retrieve analyses from federated beacons or a self-hosted database
tool.command: #if str($connection.transport) == "api" #set $filters = $connection.filters beacon2-query entity --entity analysis @PROVIDER_ARGS@ --granularity '$connection.granularity' --limit $connection.pagination.limit --skip $connection.pagination.skip #if str($connection.pagination.sample) --sample $connection.pagination.sample #end if #if str($connection.lookup.mode) == "by_id" --entity-id '$connection.lookup.entity_id' #end if @FILTER_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #else beacon2-query entity --entity analysis --transport mongodb --db-host '$connection.db_host' --db-port $connection.db_port --database '$connection.database' --collection '$connection.collection' --credentials-file '$credentials' #if str($connection.mongo_fields.aligner) --field 'aligner=$connection.mongo_fields.aligner' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.analysisDate) --field 'analysisDate=$connection.mongo_fields.analysisDate' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.biosampleId) --field 'biosampleId=$connection.mongo_fields.biosampleId' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.identification) --entity-id '$connection.mongo_fields.identification' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.individualId) --field 'individualId=$connection.mongo_fields.individualId' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.pipelineName) --field 'pipelineName=$connection.mongo_fields.pipelineName' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.pipelineRef) --field 'pipelineRef=$connection.mongo_fields.pipelineRef' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.runId) --field 'runId=$connection.mongo_fields.runId' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.variantCaller) --field 'variantCaller=$connection.mongo_fields.variantCaller' #end if @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #end if

param.name: entity_id
param.label: Identifier
param.help: As used by that beacon. Identifiers are local to each beacon.

section.name: mongo_fields
section.title: Fields to match (each one exact; all must match)

param.name: aligner
param.label: ALIGNER
param.help: Reference to mapping/alignment software. Example bwa-0.7.8 Matched exactly against aligner.

param.name: analysisDate
param.label: ANALYSIS DATE
param.help: Date at which analysis was performed. Example 2021-10-17 Matched exactly against analysisDate.

param.name: biosampleId
param.label: BIOSAMPLE ID
param.help: Reference to the id of the biosample this analysis is reporting on. Example S0001 Matched exactly against biosampleId.

param.name: identification
param.label: ID
param.help: Analysis reference ID (external accession or internal ID). Example GA.01234abcde

param.name: individualId
param.label: INDIVIDUALID
param.help: Reference to the id of the individual this analysis is reporting on. Example P0001 Matched exactly against individualId.

param.name: pipelineName
param.label: PIPELINE NAME
param.help: Analysis pipeline and version if a standardized pipeline was used. Example Pipeline-panel-0001-v1 Matched exactly against pipelineName.

param.name: pipelineRef
param.label: PIPELINE REF
param.help: Link to Analysis pipeline resource Matched exactly against pipelineRef.

param.name: runId
param.label: RUNID
param.help: Run identifier (external accession or internal ID). Example SRR10903401 Matched exactly against runId.

param.name: variantCaller
param.label: VARIANT CALLER
param.help: Reference to variant calling software / pipeline. Example GATK4.0 Matched exactly against variantCaller.

tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Retrieves analysis records from the beacons you select, or from a self-hosted Beacon MongoDB database.
**Two ways to narrow a query, one per connection**
On the *Beacon v2 API* the tool takes **filters**: ontology terms such as ``NCIT:C3058``, which each beacon maps onto its own records. The API has no way to match a field's value directly.
On a *self-hosted MongoDB* the tool takes **fields**: the same named fields the 2.2.x tools offered, each matched exactly against a document path shown in its help. A raw collection has no mapping from ontology terms to fields, so filters are not offered there.
@HELP_OUTPUTS@
